sloka: बहिष्कृतो ऽहमर्थेषु सन्निकर्षाच्च पार्थिव ।प्रतिगृह्णातु वै राजन्क सहाश्नाति भोजनम् ।। ७.५९.५ ।।
transliteration: bahiṣkṛto 'hamartheṣu sannikarṣācca pārthiva ।pratigṛhṇātu vai rājanka sahāśnāti bhojanam ।। 7.59.5 ।।

translations.english: O King, I am excluded from worldly pleasures due to old age; who indeed would eat food with me?
